{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Sweet Potato Seeds |Crop = Sweet Potato |Growth = 12 days |Season = {{Season|Fall}} |Sell Price = 45 |gPrice = {{GS Price|seeds|45}} |jPrice = {{JM Price|seeds|45}} |tPrice = {{Tprice|45}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Fall}}. Mature plants yield [[Sweet Potato]] after 12 days. Seeds can be purchased at [[Stardew:Pierre's General Store|Pierre's General Store]], [[JojaMart]], and at the Traveling Cart, but they can also be obtained by placing Sweet Potato in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants yield a single Sweet Potato per harvest. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Sweet Potato}} {{clear}}
